subject: Re: Apology for the scheduling mix-up
text:
Thank you for following up on yesterday's exchange. I owe you a clear apology for the mix-up, which I understand was inconvenient and likely added to an already busy week. I realize the original notice was not precise enough, and I appreciate the thoughtful way you flagged the issue before the date moved forward. The error came from our side, not from anything you did, and I have spoken with the team about correcting the record and improving our confirmation process. I will personally check that the revised calendar entry remains correct. I hope this avoids further disruption to your lecture schedule.

I also wanted to add one helpful suggestion that may make the revised arrangement easier to manage. If you would like, we can record the session and share the video afterward, so you would not need to cover the same ground twice if your availability changes again. Alternatively, we can keep the updated slot as it is and provide a short outline in advance, giving you more time to adjust the material you wish to present.

Thank you for your patience and for your understanding. Please tell me which option feels most useful, and I will make sure everything is arranged quietly and correctly this time.
